beats.say: The BBC has denied reports of a complaint on The Celebrity Traitors.
Reports suggested James Acaster complained about macho banter from Romesh Ranganathan and Rob Beckett.
The allegations claimed the trio clashed during filming of the celebrity special.
But the BBC says this is categorically untrue.
They state that claims of teasing amongst the cast are false.
The broadcaster says there were no incidents and no evidence to support the claims.
Are you watching the new series of The Celebrity Traitors?

meta.summary: The BBC has officially denied claims that James Acaster made a complaint regarding banter from his co-stars on The Celebrity Traitors.
facts: The BBC denied that James Acaster complained about teasing or banter from Romesh Ranganathan and Rob Beckett on the show.
The BBC stated that claims of teasing amongst the cast on the show and claims of complaints about teasing are categorically untrue.
The BBC stated that there were no incidents of that nature and there is no evidence to support the allegations.
